A deliberately lost committed response leaves Save disabled; rereading confirms the exact identity/source/relations without another create command.

Reopening scene physics2d resolves the existing document, offers source editing and keeps the selected scene without allocating or creating another manifest.

GUI Plan, Build and actual Godot headless Run use the newly created and ordinarily saved declaration: character stops at x≈131, sensor emits enter/exit with actual bound instance IDs, and animation runs idle/action/idle under unchanged protocol 10.
